=📊 Daily Market Research Complete!
Report saved to MongoDB.
Check dashboard for trending products & opportunities.

=📸 Instagram post ready!

Caption preview:
{{$('Format Post').first().json.caption.slice(0,200)}}...

Reels idea: {{$('Format Post').first().json.reels_idea}}

Approve to schedule.

=Analyze these Google Trends results together with our active product catalog. Identify trending opportunities. Return ONLY valid JSON with fields: trending_topics (array), recommended_products (array), summary (string).

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

=Write a compelling product description. Return ONLY valid JSON with fields: caption, seo_keywords (array).

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}

=Write a blog post. Return ONLY valid JSON with fields: title, body, tags (array).

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}

=Write marketing email copy. Return ONLY valid JSON with fields: subject, body.

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}

=Write a set of frequently asked questions. Return ONLY valid JSON with field: faqs (array of {question, answer}).

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}

=Translate the following text into {{ $json.lang_name }}. Return ONLY the translated text, no explanation, no quotes.

{{ $json.source_text }}

=Create Instagram content for this product. Return ONLY valid JSON with fields: caption, hashtags (array), reels_idea (string).

Product: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

=Write a Facebook page post. Return ONLY valid JSON with field: post_text.

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}

=Write a friendly reply to this Facebook comment. Return ONLY valid JSON with field: reply_text.

Comment: {{ $json.body.comment_text }}

=Write Facebook ad copy. Return ONLY valid JSON with fields: headline, primary_text, cta.

Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}
={{$('Groq - Write Report').first().json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content}}

parameters.subject: ={{JSON.parse($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}').subject || 'Business Inquiry'}}
parameters.text: ={{JSON.parse($json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}').email_body || ''}}
